messages.text:
The best score acts strangely. A worse game can replace it, and a size I've never finished shows 0. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Fixed both score issues:

- [storage.ts](/work/src/game/session/storage.ts:61) now keeps an existing best when a completed game is equal or worse, and replaces it only with fewer moves.
- [GameStatus.tsx](/work/src/game/status/GameStatus.tsx:30) displays `Best: none` when that size has no record.

Typecheck passed, all 140 unit and static checks passed, and all 77 browser checks passed. The project-wide format check still reports 13 pre-existing formatting issues in unrelated files; neither changed file is among them.
